content.scope: Interconnect Architect | CMN GUI Lead | Tools for internal engineers and external customers.

recognition.text: Most Innovative Award, Engineering AI Showcase (Dec 2025), for a project-agnostic multi-agent orchestration and context-gathering system.

ai_platform.text: Designed a modular AI engineering platform with four project packs, separating shared tooling from product-owned runtimes through manifest-driven configuration.

workspace.text: Built isolated workspaces with dedicated ports, caches and editor state; coordinated concurrent checkout allocation through atomic locks, tokenized leases and ownership-checked recovery.

workbench.text: Built a Rust/Tauri 2 workbench with React/TypeScript UI, a shared desktop/CLI core, bounded asynchronous Git inspection and verified process controls.

ci_repair.text: Built Jenkins/LSF repair tooling for exact-revision replay and binary patch transfer; required three consecutive clean replays of the latest patch before finalizing flaky-test fixes.

release.text: Built resumable RHEL 8/LSF release automation with archive checks and packaged acceptance, preserving payload hashes/permissions and verifying source/dependency provenance.

packaged_agents.text: Built immutable macOS/Windows modules and isolated AI-agent verification in fresh sessions, checking payload integrity, MCP registration, provider routing and runtime cleanup.

catalog.text: Implemented deterministic capability catalogs with SHA-256 freshness checks and explicit runtime availability; made skill registration transactional through destination preflight, conflict rejection and rollback on partial failure.

qualification.text: Built GUI qualification and coverage orchestration with a 56-cell regression fixture spanning 28 IP projects and two renderers; preserved raw coverage and rejected resume attempts when source, matrix or dependency fingerprints changed.

mcp_validated.text: Implemented Python Model Context Protocol (MCP) planning and rollback for two bounded interconnect workflows; recorded validation lists 5,063 full-suite passes and 92 live checks.

migration.text: Built a Python NIC-400 XML/CCXML migration engine that reconstructs topology and routes while preserving placement; historical validation recorded 4,130/4,130 valid configurations passing design-rule checks and 5/5 curated invalid configurations rejected.

mcp.text: Designed and implemented Python tooling using Model Context Protocol (MCP) for two bounded interconnect construction workflows, with typed intent, dependency-ordered plans, checkpointed execution, semantic validation and rollback.

canvas.text: Developed Angular/Electron topology editors in TypeScript, with 64x64 mesh coordinates and shared route-aware layout and interactions across SVG/Pixi renderers.

placement.text: Implemented grid-aligned physical auto-placement with collision avoidance, grouping and die sizing; tested overlap, containment and adjacency across both renderers.

tests.text: Created Playwright infrastructure for newer NoC tooling and built Electron-hosted Karma execution; expanded regressions for renderer behavior, persistence and cross-layer workflows.

async.text: Prevented stale or concurrent design-rule responses from updating the wrong view using request IDs and reload checks; added unit and end-to-end regressions.

mcp_detail.text: Architected Python Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling to compile typed design intent into dependency-ordered operations, execute against checkpoints, verify postconditions and support rollback and reproducible Python/YAML exports.

mcp_validation.text: Built acceptance and bounded agent-evaluation infrastructure for two interconnect construction workflows; recorded results include 5,063 full-suite passes, 92 live checks and exact configuration-hash restoration in a rollback evaluation.

sidecar.text: Implemented current/legacy Python runtime routing and an authenticated sidecar with API allowlisting, path restrictions, provenance checks and parent-lifetime cleanup.

docs.text: Created reproducible source-aware documentation collection and rendering tools, source indexes and task-to-code navigation for the Angular engineering application.

guided.text: Delivered NoC-Lite configuration using Python policies and Angular editors, with product constraints, versioned state, recovery and compliance status invalidated by design changes.

owo.text: Built an Ordered Write Observation wizard for topology, credit/buffer limits and address constraints, with review/apply/restore operations and unit/Playwright tests.

diagnostics.text: Built interactive deadlock investigation and route visualization, and semantic configuration comparisons across isolated backend sessions, comparing instances, interfaces, connections, attributes, routes and source YAML.

performance.text: Optimized canvas interaction using cached DOM geometry, frame-batched pointer updates and processing outside Angular change detection; repaired observer and subscription cleanup.

tests_detail.text: Created NoC Playwright infrastructure and Electron-hosted Karma execution with dynamic loopback ports and isolated logs; added or extended 51 Angular spec files in one change.

pelion_ml.text: Implemented Flask services to start and stop Jupyter notebooks and persist files in AWS EFS for Pelion's embedded-ML platform; defined PostgreSQL schemas and built end-to-end tests.

occupancy.text: Built sensor-ingestion and dashboard APIs with InfluxDB, including a fixed-radius neighbor algorithm for workspace proximity detection.

rtl.text: Designed safety-mechanism RTL for lightweight non-coherent interconnects; used waveform viewers to debug testbenches and RTL/IP during RTL and VIP simulation rotations.

fpga.text: Built Verilog FPGA modules and Mbed OS firmware for I2C, GPIO, ADC, DAC and PWM; contributed to shield/form-factor PCBs. 2020 Arm Quality Award (team).

analytics.text: Built Node.js/Express REST APIs, PostgreSQL schemas and React dashboards to monitor occupancy from thermal cameras and PIR sensors.

internships.text: Earlier Arm internships: IoT Engineering (May-Aug 2018), Systems & Software IP (May-Aug 2017), ATG Verification Enablement (May-Aug 2016), and IT (Oct 2014-Aug 2015).

internship_work.text: Initiated the FPGA test shield, integrated an ATECC608A cryptography library with Mbed I2C, delivered an embedded-logic-analyzer trace decompression script to customers, and built Python/SQLite tooling for architectural test data.

cmn_gui.text: Created all coherent-mesh (CMN) GUI tooling from CMN-800 onward, including Multi-CHI port devices, MCS group configuration, custom routing and mesh deadlock detection interfaces.

# Michael Remington Coulter

Buda, TX | [mrcoulter45@gmail.com](mailto:mrcoulter45@gmail.com) | (760) 694-6310
[linkedin.com/in/michael-coulter-164868153](https://www.linkedin.com/in/michael-coulter-164868153/) | [github.com/mrcoulter45](https://github.com/mrcoulter45)

Senior Software Engineer with nearly 8 years shipping and maintaining production engineering software. Build shared Codex harnesses and MCP tools used in Arm engineering workflows.

## Professional Experience

**Arm - Austin, TX**

### Senior Software Engineer | Apr 2023 - Present

Ship and maintain Interconnect Architect, Arm's Angular/TypeScript and Python SoC configuration tool. The product has about six years of customer releases and ships internally twice a month.

**Recognition:** Most Innovative Award, Engineering AI Showcase (Dec 2025): multi-agent system.

- Develop and operate a shared Codex harness used by several Arm engineers, with reusable tools/skills, project context and automatic capture/retrieval of persistent engineering memory.
    - Created `repair-jenkins`, a team-used Codex skill to identify failing Playwright tests and autonomously fix flakiness, test-code defects and underlying source bugs; requires three consecutive passes and human patch review. Replaces hours-to-days manual debugging; cluster skills use user-scoped write policies and LSF scheduling.
    - Developed a Rust/Tauri 2 workbench with React UI and shared desktop/CLI core.
- Engineered `ia-mcp`, an internal Python MCP interface used by several engineers for configuration, with typed plans, checkpoints, semantic validation and backend fallback.
    - Implemented Codex-driven NCI/CMN evaluations on installed modules, checking valid builds, DRC, artifacts and cleanup; verified exact configuration-hash restoration in rollback. Separately passed 92 real-engine contract/integration cases.
    - Built `ia-mcp` on Python 3.13; product-aware routing runs current backends directly and legacy Python 3.7 in an isolated, authenticated subprocess with exact-version checks.
- CMN GUI Lead: created and own all coherent-mesh GUI tooling from CMN-800 onward. Deliver features requested by licensees and technical leads; contribute to shared Python backend APIs in a product supporting Arm interconnect licensing.

### Software Engineer | Apr 2020 - Apr 2023

- Built Flask services for Pelion's Jupyter notebooks, persisting files through Kubernetes storage backed by AWS EFS; designed PostgreSQL schemas and end-to-end tests.

### Graduate Software Engineer | Jan 2019 - Apr 2020

- Built Verilog I/O test modules and C++ firmware for the Arm Mbed OS FPGA Test Shield.

## Technical Skills

**Languages:** Python, Rust, TypeScript/JavaScript, C++, SQL  
**Agent systems:** MCP, tool integration, persistent memory, semantic validation, checkpointing, rollback  
**Platform:** Python packaging; Angular, React, Flask, PostgreSQL; Kubernetes, Jenkins/LSF, CI/CD  

## Education

**The University of Texas at Austin**
Bachelor of Science, Electrical and Computer Engineering | Dec 2018
Primary focus: Computer Architecture and Embedded Systems | Secondary: Integrated Circuits
